rent.notes: RealAdvisor Oct 2026 Morbihan houses average 129 EUR/m2/yr (about 10.75 EUR/m2/mo); a 90-100 m2 pet-friendly 2-3BR house is about 970-1075 EUR. Rennes metro runs higher, inland Brittany lower; TEOM trash charge typically passed to tenant in charges.

electricity.notes: EDF tarif bleu. ~8,000 kWh/yr. Electric radiator supplement in older homes. No A/C needed.

gas.notes: Engie/GRDF. Natural gas central heating (Oct–Apr primary). Cooking.

water.notes: Veolia/Suez. Includes assainissement (sewage treatment). ~120m³/yr for 2 adults.

sewage.notes: Included in water bill as assainissement collectif.

trash.notes: TEOM (taxe d'enlèvement des ordures ménagères) included in rent — €18/mo.

utilities.taxes: TVA included in bills: 5.5% on water/assainissement, 20% on electricity/gas.
utilities.notes: Electricity on EDF Tarif Bleu Base 9 kVA (0.1985 EUR/kWh, 238.56 EUR/yr subscription from 1 Aug 2026) at about 5,000 kWh/yr = about 103 EUR/mo; natural gas heating stored 60 EUR scaled by INSEE gas +19.0% y/y = about 71 EUR; water+assainissement stored 40 EUR (not re-verified). Excludes internet.

sources.title: Kelwatt - Evolution du Tarif Bleu au 1er aout 2026

healthcare.notes: PUMA base coverage for residents plus a mutuelle for a couple age 60: Reassurez-moi average about 120 EUR/mo for a senior couple 60-75; Meilleurtaux 2026 study 248.82 EUR/mo for a couple of 60 with reinforced cover. Possible PUMA cotisation subsidiaire maladie on capital income not modeled.

sources.title: LeComparateurAssurance - Prix de la mutuelle sante en 2026

petCare.notes: Vet visits, vaccinations, flea/tick, pet insurance

petDaycare.notes: Hired pet sitter 2 days/week (~€28/visit). Commercial daycare (garde canine) limited in Brittany; in-home pet sitting more common. Large breed surcharge applies. Rover.com and local garde d'animaux services.

petGrooming.notes: Bernese coat maintenance, professional grooming monthly

entertainment.notes: Incl cable+1Gig internet, Netflix, Amazon Prime, Apple TV+, dining out (lunch for 2 2x/week w/ tax+tip)

phoneCell.notes: Google Fi Flexible (US Number) + Free Mobile (Local). 2 phones, 1.5GB+ high-speed data each, all taxes included.

buffer.notes: Monthly safety buffer for unexpected expenses

medicalOOP.notes: ALD status for hypertension/diabetes provides 100% Sécu coverage on related care. Anti-VEGF injections performed at hospital: 100% covered. Mutuelle covers ticket modérateur and dépassements d'honoraires. OOP mainly for non-remboursé items, some specialist surcharges, and comfort options.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. Based on jurisdiction's effective retiree rate; excludes sales/VAT/property tax.

stateIncomeTax.label: French Income Tax
stateIncomeTax.exemptions: US-France treaty prevents double taxation. Foreign tax credit offsets. SS taxed only in France at 6.6% after allowance.

salesTax.notes: No separate sales tax (VAT included in prices)

propertyTax.notes: Taxe d'habitation abolished for primary residence

taxes.notes: US-France tax treaty. Foreign tax credit offsets French tax against US federal.

pros.text: Excellent healthcare via PUMA (Protection Universelle Maladie) — universal access for residents under Code SS Art. L160-1

sources.title: Code de la sécurité sociale — Article L160-1 (Protection Universelle Maladie)

cons.text: Complex tax situation: US persons remain subject to US tax under the 1994 US-France treaty (saving clause); FBAR/FATCA reporting still required

sources.title: Convention fiscale franco-américaine du 31 août 1994 (with 2004/2009 protocols)

cons.text: Safety & crime: see cited reports for current figures by city and country

exchangeRates.note: EUR per 1 USD. Based on 2016-2026 historical range. Optimistic = strong EUR (good for USD→EUR), Pessimistic = weak EUR.
